mechanism: A mobility proof becomes meaningful when an identified carrier departs, demonstrates one unmistakable capability upgrade, crosses a legible route, arrives at a specific destination, and hands the sequence to a human-scale benefit. The beneficiary action must visibly consume or use the delivered result rather than merely posing beside it.

invariants.rule: Establish the carrier and departure point before accelerating the route.
invariants.purpose: Gives the journey a concrete origin.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening mid-flight removes the state change and route promise.

invariants.rule: Use one visible capability upgrade that changes how the carrier traverses space.
invariants.purpose: Creates a technical proof rather than ordinary travel.
invariants.ablation_failure: Decorative light with no route effect is not an upgrade.

invariants.rule: Preserve a readable destination transition instead of random travel montage.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated locations make the journey untraceable.

invariants.rule: Present the delivered object or service in tactile close detail at arrival.
invariants.purpose: Turns distance into a concrete result.
invariants.ablation_failure: Skipping arrival detail leaves the benefit abstract.

invariants.rule: End with a beneficiary visibly using the result.
invariants.ablation_failure: A product beauty shot does not prove human benefit.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
